purpose: one-shot arbitration between the predeclared v12 equal blend and PE-only runtime default

gate.license_boundary: the pinned dataset card states no reusable licence; evaluation only and do not redistribute
gate.prior_use_boundary: the pixels were consumed by the historical v11 quality-router experiment, but neither exact v12 candidate has been scored on them

evaluation.conditions: clean plus the 19 individually applied workshop transformations
evaluation.codec_contract: each condition is followed by label-independent JPEG q96 normalization
evaluation.primary_metric: 0.5 * clean ROC AUC + 0.5 * pooled transformed ROC AUC

frozen_default_decision.otherwise: retain the fixed equal blend as default
frozen_default_decision.fallback: PE-only remains a separately runnable fallback regardless of the decision
frozen_default_decision.forbidden_after_opening: no threshold, preprocessing, candidate or blend-weight search on these rows

interpretation: This gate is class-balanced, all-JPEG, source-coherent and generator-blind, so it is a useful final tie-breaker. It is from a different competition and was previously opened by another lineage, so it is not a fresh hidden-set estimate or evidence that every unseen generator is covered.
